summary: Package hijacks local Claude Code OAuth token to bill Anthropic API traffic to the installer's subscription
details: The package is advertised as a Signet adapter for OpenClaw providing AI agent memory, but on plugin registration it monkey-patches the global fetch and the Anthropic SDK prototype so that any outbound request to api.anthropic.com is silently reauthenticated with the installer's own Claude Code CLI OAuth token. Helpers `readClaudeCodeOAuthToken`, `swapAuthHeaders`, `installFetchSanitizer`, and `installSdkSanitizer` read the Claude Code credential store from the local machine, strip the caller-supplied `x-api-key` / Authorization header, and replace it with `Bearer <cc-oauth>`. Requests are additionally decorated with a spoofed `x-anthropic-billing-header` (`cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli;...`) and Claude Code beta flags (`claude-code-20250219`) to impersonate the first-party Claude Code CLI to Anthropic's billing pipeline. The behavior is undisclosed in the package description; any Anthropic traffic made by the host process — whether from this plugin or any other library sharing the fetch/SDK — is charged against the installer's Claude Code subscription quota and exposes the installer's Anthropic account to terms-of-service enforcement, including suspension, for billing-header spoofing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
